chars.GIRLFRIEND: GIRLFRIEND: a 19-year-old Moroccan young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.MOM: MOM: an elegant Moroccan woman in her early forties with shoulder-length chestnut hair, wearing an emerald-green satin blouse, black straight trousers and gold hoop earrings
chars.BOY: BOY: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man with short black curly hair, wearing a burgundy bomber jacket over a black t-shirt and grey joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the doorway of a modern Casablanca apartment living room, head-to-waist framing: GIRLFRIEND stands next to a packed suitcase, holding both hands out pleading and looking straight toward the viewer with big worried eyes, mid-sentence, as if asking a serious favour. Warm evening light. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the same Casablanca apartment by the front door: GIRLFRIEND grips BOY's hands tightly, eyes teary, begging him earnestly; BOY listens, surprised and a bit awkward. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A modern Moroccan kitchen in Casablanca: MOM, alone, struggles with a leaking sink tap, water spraying, she looks over her shoulder helplessly but smiling with a hint of mischief. Medium shot, face visible. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan dining table with a tajine and mint tea: GIRLFRIEND points at BOY while talking to MOM, presenting him like family; MOM smiles warmly at BOY; BOY sits shyly. Cosy apartment, daylight. 2D animated storybook style, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca Mohammed V airport departures hall: GIRLFRIEND walks away toward the gate pulling her suitcase, turning back to wave; in the foreground BOY stands alone with a lost, uneasy face. 2D animated storybook style, no text.
